entities.summary: Martin Chabada is a Czech professional ice hockey player currently with HC Litoměřice of the 1. národní hokejová liga (CZE.1). He has formerly played with HC Sparta Praha of the Czech Extraliga and Luleå HF in the Swedish Hockey League. He was originally drafted 252nd overall in the 2002 NHL Entry Draft by the New York Islanders.
